bio.text: Michele Tafoya, a former sports broadcaster, won the Republican nomination for U.S. Senate in Minnesota in the August 11, 2026 primary.
According to her KAXE candidate survey response, she worked nearly three decades as a sideline reporter, covering five Super Bowls and five Olympic Games, and later hosted a political podcast.
In that response she said she lives in Edina and earned an MBA from the University of Southern California.

sources.title: Michele Tafoya wins Republican nomination for U.S. Senate
